{{Quote|What the hell was that?|Hevy after watching an eel eat Cutup|audio=WhatTheHellWasThat-Rookies.flac|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Rishi eel''' was a predator native to the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Rishi moon|moon]]. They dwelt in caves of the moon's canyons and had a mouth with four mandibles. They were one of several [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Eel/Legends|eel]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
[[File:RishiEel-Rookies.png|thumb|left|220px|A Rishi eel looms over rookie clone troopers]]
{{Quote|Don't forget about those giant eels.|Hevy|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
[[21 BBY/Legends|During]] the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Rishi eel killed and ate the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] rookie known as [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]]. An eel, possibly the same one that ate Cutup, was shot and killed instantly by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], after receiving an expertly aimed shot through its eye and into its brain. He then marked the "shiny" armor of [[Echo/Legends|Echo]] with the animal's blue blood. Later on during the Clone Wars, ARC Trooper Fives had a Rishi eel design on the top of his helmet as a tribute to Cutup.
